note: Each prompt is what a person would ask, in a fresh session, with the web tools an agent has anyway beside the node's. None names the node: the check is whether the agent reaches for it unprompted. `none` is a control: a task needing no website must not touch it, so calling it on everything can't pass.

tasks.prompt: What are the top three trending repositories on GitHub (github.com/trending) right now? Just list their names.
What is the latest released version of the requests package on PyPI right now?
Search the Internet Archive for Apollo 11 films and list three titles it shows.
Search GOV.UK for passport renewal and give me the title of the first result.
Sign in to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login with my saved login and tell me what the page says once you're in.
In one sentence, what does an HTTP 404 status mean?
